title: Folded Note
description: A note someone left on the table, folded in quarters. Drag a panel to open it one fold at a time: the paper lifts on its crease, curls under your hand and lays flat with the crease still catching the low light. Fold it back up and the creases deepen.
intent: Paper as the material and a few handwritten lines as the content: one sheet, two folds, and light that remembers every crease.

sources.name: Paper Design, Paper Shaders paper-texture (Apache-2.0)
sources.what: getFiber and getRoughness ported into a one-time bake (5-octave rotated fibre gradient, 4-octave roughness with laid-paper row bands), plus the idea of crease lighting with its own slope term and broken-fibre darkening along the fold line.

sources.name: La Belle Aurore by Kimberly Geswein (SIL Open Font License 1.1)
sources.what: The handwriting the note is written in. Licence file kept beside the font.

sources.name: Lenis, damp
sources.what: Frame-rate independent damp for the camera reframing after each fold.
